FEATURES

Everything You Need to Manage Procurement

A centralized platform connecting vendors and suppliers throughout the complete purchasing lifecycle.

Product Management

Suppliers can add and manage products, prices, stock quantities, descriptions and images.

Product Discovery

Vendors can search supplier products and find the materials they need quickly.

RFQ Management

Vendors can send quotation requests while suppliers can review and respond to RFQs.

Quotation Management

Suppliers submit quotations with pricing, quantities, delivery time and terms.

Purchase Orders

Accepted quotations automatically become purchase orders for streamlined procurement.

Inventory Management

Suppliers can monitor available stock and manage inventory levels for their products.

Order & Delivery Tracking

Track orders from confirmation and shipment through final delivery.

Analytics

Visualize RFQs, purchase orders, inventory and purchasing activity through charts.

HOW IT WORKS

From Request to Delivery

Manage the complete procurement process through a simple workflow.

01

Find Products

Vendors browse and search products available from suppliers.

02

Request Quotation

Vendors send an RFQ with quantity and delivery requirements.

03

Receive Quotation

Suppliers review the request and submit their quotation.

04

Place Order

Vendors accept a quotation and generate a purchase order.

05

Track Delivery

Suppliers ship the order and vendors confirm the delivery.
